(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 3: INDUCTIVE COMPENSATION & RESISTIVE QUENCH VOLTAGE CALCULATION                            *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The terminal voltage across a superconducting magnet contains both resistive and inductive parts:    *)
(*   V_terminal = V_resistive + L * (dI/dt) + sum(M_ij * dI_j/dt) + M_plasma * (dI_plasma/dt)         *)
(* During current ramp-up, L*(dI/dt) can reach hundreds of Volts, whereas a quench starts at 100 mV.    *)
(* Precise real-time numerical differentiation and inductive subtraction are mathematically mandatory. *)

(* 3.1 Two-Stage 2nd-Order Low-Pass Filtered Derivative for Magnet Current *)
rRawDerivative_kA_s := (rVoterCurrent_kA - rCurrent_PrevScan_kA) / rCycleTime_s;
rCurrent_PrevScan_kA := rVoterCurrent_kA;

(* 2nd-Order Filter: damping ratio zeta = 0.707, cutoff frequency omega_n = 150 rad/s (~24 Hz) *)
rDerivFilterState_1 := rDerivFilterState_1 + (rRawDerivative_kA_s - rDerivFilterState_1) * (150.0 * rCycleTime_s);
rDerivFilterState_2 := rDerivFilterState_2 + (rDerivFilterState_1 - rDerivFilterState_2) * (150.0 * rCycleTime_s);
rCurrentDerivative_kA_s := rDerivFilterState_2;

(* 3.2 Plasma Current Coupling Derivative (dI_p/dt) *)
rPlasmaDeriv_MA_s := (rPlasmaCurrent_MA - rPlasmaCurrent_Prev_MA) / rCycleTime_s;
rPlasmaCurrent_Prev_MA := rPlasmaCurrent_MA;

(* 3.3 Inductive Compensation Potential [mV] *)
(* V_ind = [L_eff (uH) * dI/dt (kA/s) + M_p (uH) * dIp/dt (MA/s * 1000)] -> Result in Volts * 1000 = mV *)
rInductiveVoltageComp_mV := (rMutualInductanceEquivalent_uH * rCurrentDerivative_kA_s) + 
                            (rPlasmaMutualInductance_uH * (rPlasmaDeriv_MA_s * 1000.0));

(* 3.4 Pure Resistive Quench Potential [mV] *)
rResistiveVoltage_mV := rVoterCoilVoltage_mV - rInductiveVoltageComp_mV;

(* Offset baseline compensation when current is stationary *)
IF ABS(rCurrentDerivative_kA_s) < 0.05 THEN
    IF ABS(rResistiveVoltage_mV) < 5.0 THEN
        rResistiveVoltage_mV := 0.0; (* Zero-deadband noise filter *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 4: SUPERCONDUCTING QUENCH DETECTION CRITERIA ENGINE                                         *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Multi-physics quench criteria evaluated in parallel:                                                *)
(* 1. Electrical criterion: V_res > 100 mV sustained for > 15 ms (or > 300 mV for > 3 ms).             *)
(* 2. Thermal criterion: Temperature margin Delta T_m = T_cs(B, I) - T_out < 0.50 K.                  *)
(* 3. Hydraulic criterion: Supercritical Helium shockwave dP/dt > 1.50 bar/s.                          *)
(* 4. Acoustic burst criterion: High-frequency emissions > 92 dB correlated with V_res > 40 mV.         *)

(* 4.1 Magnetic Field and Nb3Sn Current Sharing Temperature (T_cs) Evaluation *)
(* Empirical parameterization for ITER Central Solenoid Nb3Sn CICC: B_peak = 0.288 T/kA * I_CS *)
rPeakMagneticField_T := ABS(rVoterCurrent_kA) * 0.2888;
IF rPeakMagneticField_T > 13.5 THEN
    rPeakMagneticField_T := 13.5;
END_IF;

(* Critical temperature reduction under high magnetic field and transport current: *)
(* T_cs = T_c0 * (1 - B/B_c20)^0.59 * (1 - I/I_c0)^0.5 *)
(* For CS Nb3Sn: T_c0 = 18.0 K, B_c20 = 28.0 T. At 13 T, 40 kA: T_cs ~ 6.2 K - 6.8 K *)
rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K := 18.0 * SQRT(MAX(0.01, 1.0 - (rPeakMagneticField_T / 28.0))) * 
                             SQRT(MAX(0.01, 1.0 - (ABS(rVoterCurrent_kA) / 65.0)));
IF rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K < 4.80 THEN
    rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K := 4.80; (* Lower physical floor *)
END_IF;

(* Temperature Margin [K] *)

(* 4.2 Supercritical Helium Pressure and Temperature Transient Rates *)
rPressureRate_bar_s := (rVoterPressure_bar - rPressure_PrevScan_bar) / rCycleTime_s;
rPressure_PrevScan_bar := rVoterPressure_bar;
rPressureDerivFilter_1 := rPressureDerivFilter_1 + (rPressureRate_bar_s - rPressureDerivFilter_1) * (80.0 * rCycleTime_s);

rTemperature_PrevScan_K := rVoterTemp_K;

(* 4.3 Multi-Criteria Quench Discrimination Logic *)
(* Criterion A: Standard Resistive Voltage Sustained Integration *)

    rQuenchValidationTimer_s := rQuenchValidationTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

    END_IF;

    (* Fast-track extreme overvoltage threshold: 3 ms response *)
    rQuenchValidationTimer_s := rQuenchValidationTimer_s + (rCycleTime_s * 5.0);
    IF rQuenchValidationTimer_s >= 0.015 THEN
        bVoltageQuenchLatched := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    rQuenchValidationTimer_s := MAX(0.0, rQuenchValidationTimer_s - (rCycleTime_s * 2.0));
END_IF;

    bCryoQuenchLatched := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Cryogenic Supercritical Helium Heat Flux Quench *)
END_IF;

(* Criterion C: Acoustic Micro-Fracture Burst Quench *)

    bAcousticQuenchLatched := TRUE;

    bQuenchDetected := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Master Quench Protection Tripped *)
